data.body: Landed: change 1323 merged to main as 6739ea54fa (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1). Evidence per AC: (1) CI wall runs scripts/check_raw_git_writes.py — raw-git-write gate step in _build-and-test.yml; module-agnostic Python AST scan + cwd-aware workflow/shell scan; teaching message names run_git_write/event_append/txn seams. (2) Single inline marker '# raw-git-ok: <reason>' with mandatory reason — marker-without-reason fires; relationship to tickets-boundary-ok documented in lint header + docs/architecture.md. (3) Full bootstrap inventory dispositioned: 108 hits (107 original + measure_baseline_normalization.py landed during review) — every hit remediated or reasoned-marked incl. per-module _git maintenance callers, review_bot/gerrit_client + opcert_service/workspace disposable-workspace sites; tree clean at landing (enforce mode exits 0); reconcile-bridge.yml historical shape covered by failing test fixture. (4) Lint unit tests: no-tracker-context negative control, splat + plain-list variable-argv positives (git_adapter.commit/update_ref/rm_cached, event_append._git_commit_paths), opaque-argv fail-closed (_ref_lock._git delegation), residual limitation (cross-function argv construction) documented in lint header.
